meta.author: self
meta.note: 全部自撰，不复制任何真题原文

items.zh: 这座古城以其悠久的历史和独特的建筑吸引了众多游客。
items.reference: This ancient city attracts numerous tourists with its long history and unique architecture.
hints: 得分点：古城 / 吸引 / 众多游客 / 以其悠久的历史 / 独特的建筑
「以……吸引」可用 attract sb. with sth.；architecture 表「建筑风格」时为不可数名词
句型：This ancient city attracts numerous tourists with its long history and unique architecture.

items.zh: 旅游不仅能开阔眼界，还能让人深入了解不同的文化。
items.reference: Travelling can not only broaden one's horizons but also help people gain a deeper understanding of different cultures.
hints: 得分点：不仅 / 开阔眼界 / 而且 / 深入了解 / 不同的文化
「开阔眼界」固定搭配为 broaden / widen one's horizons，horizon 常用复数
句型：Travelling can not only … but also help people gain a deeper understanding of …

items.zh: 出发前，游客最好提前预订机票和酒店。
items.reference: Before departure, tourists had better book their flights and hotels in advance.
hints: 得分点：出发前 / 最好 / 预订 / 提前
「最好做」用 had better do，后接动词原形；「预订」用 book 或 reserve
句型：Before departure, tourists had better book … in advance.

items.zh: 这座小城位于山区，夏季气候凉爽，是避暑的好去处。
items.reference: Located in a mountainous area, this small town has a cool climate in summer and is a good place to escape the heat.
hints: 得分点：位于 / 山区 / 气候凉爽 / 好去处 / 避暑
「位于」可用过去分词短语 located in / situated in 作状语；「避暑」可用 escape the heat
句型：Located in …, this small town has … and is a good place to escape the heat.

items.zh: 为了让游客有更好的体验，当地政府修复了许多历史建筑。
items.reference: In order to provide tourists with a better experience, the local government has restored many historical buildings.
hints: 得分点：为了 / 为游客提供 / 更好的体验 / 当地政府 / 修复了
「为某人提供某物」用 provide sb. with sth.；「修复（古建）」用 restore / renovate
句型：In order to provide tourists with …, the local government has restored …

items.zh: 许多人喜欢自助游，因为这样可以自由安排行程。
items.reference: Many people prefer independent travel because it allows them to arrange their itinerary freely.
hints: 得分点：更喜欢 / 自助游 / 让他们能够 / 安排行程 / 自由地
「自助游」可用 independent travel / self-guided travel；allow sb. to do 表示「使某人得以做」
句型：Many people prefer … because it allows them to arrange their itinerary freely.

items.zh: 近年来，乡村旅游因其宁静的环境而变得越来越流行。
items.reference: In recent years, rural tourism has become increasingly popular because of its peaceful environment.
hints: 得分点：近年来 / 乡村旅游 / 越来越流行 / 因其宁静的环境
「越来越……」可用 increasingly + 形容词，或 more and more + 形容词；because of 后接名词短语
句型：In recent years, … has become increasingly popular because of …

items.zh: 导游建议我们带上雨具，因为山里的天气变化无常。
items.reference: The guide advised us to bring rain gear, as the weather in the mountains is unpredictable.
hints: 得分点：建议我们 / 带上雨具 / 变化无常 / 山里
「建议某人做」用 advise sb. to do；「变化无常」可用 unpredictable / changeable
句型：The guide advised us to bring …, as the weather … is unpredictable.

items.zh: 旅行中遇到困难时，向当地人求助往往是最有效的办法。
items.reference: When you run into difficulties during a trip, turning to local people for help is often the most effective way.

keyPoints.head: turning to local people for help

hints: 得分点：遇到困难 / 旅行中 / 向当地人求助 / 最有效的办法
「遇到困难」用 run into / encounter difficulties；动名词短语可作主语
句型：When you run into difficulties …, turning to … for help is often the most effective way.

items.zh: 优美的自然风光和便捷的交通使这个小镇成为热门旅游目的地。
items.reference: The beautiful natural scenery and convenient transportation have made this small town a popular tourist destination.
hints: 得分点：自然风光 / 便捷的交通 / 使……成为 / 热门旅游目的地
「使……成为……」用 make + 宾语 + 名词（宾补）；「目的地」用 destination
句型：The beautiful natural scenery and convenient transportation have made … a popular tourist destination.

items.zh: 越来越多的年轻人喜欢在假期里背包徒步旅行。
items.reference: An increasing number of young people enjoy backpacking and hiking during their holidays.
hints: 得分点：越来越多的 / 喜欢背包旅行 / 徒步旅行 / 在假期里
「越来越多的 + 复数名词」用 an increasing number of；enjoy 后接动名词
句型：An increasing number of young people enjoy … during their holidays.

items.zh: 由于游客数量急剧增加，一些景区不得不限制每日接待人数。
items.reference: As the number of tourists has increased sharply, some scenic areas have had to limit the number of visitors they receive each day.
hints: 得分点：游客数量 / 急剧增加 / 景区 / 不得不 / 限制游客人数
「急剧」用 sharply / rapidly；「不得不」用 have to，其完成式为 have had to
句型：As the number of tourists has increased sharply, some scenic areas have had to limit …

items.zh: 品尝当地美食是旅行中最令人愉快的部分之一，因为它有助于游客了解当地文化。
items.reference: Tasting local cuisine is one of the most enjoyable parts of travelling, as it helps visitors understand the local culture.
hints: 得分点：品尝当地美食 / 最令人愉快的……之一 / 旅行的部分 / 有助于游客了解 / 当地文化
「……之一」后接复数名词 parts；as 可引导原因状语从句，语气弱于 because
句型：Tasting local cuisine is one of the most enjoyable parts of travelling, as it helps visitors understand …

items.zh: 乘坐高铁出行既省时又舒适，受到广大旅客的欢迎。
items.reference: Travelling by high-speed rail is both time-saving and comfortable, and is welcomed by a large number of passengers.
hints: 得分点：乘坐高铁出行 / 既省时又舒适 / 受到……的欢迎 / 广大旅客
「既……又……」用 both … and …；「省时的」为 time-saving；「受到欢迎」可用 be welcomed by / be popular with
句型：Travelling by … is both … and …, and is welcomed by …

items.zh: 拍照留念之前，请务必尊重当地的风俗习惯。
items.reference: Before taking photos to remember your visit, please be sure to respect local customs and traditions.
hints: 得分点：拍照 / 务必 / 尊重 / 当地的风俗习惯
「务必做」可用 be sure to do / make sure to do；「风俗习惯」可用 customs and traditions
句型：Before taking photos …, please be sure to respect local customs and traditions.

items.zh: 这家旅行社因提供优质服务而在业界享有良好的声誉。
items.reference: This travel agency enjoys a good reputation in the industry for providing high-quality service.
hints: 得分点：旅行社 / 享有良好的声誉 / 在业界 / 优质服务
「享有……声誉」动词用 enjoy 或 have；for 引出原因，后接动名词 providing
句型：This travel agency enjoys a good reputation in the industry for doing sth.

items.zh: 如果时间充裕，游客可以沿着湖边散步，欣赏日落。
items.reference: If time permits, visitors can take a walk along the lake and enjoy the sunset.
hints: 得分点：如果时间充裕 / 散步 / 沿着湖边 / 欣赏日落
「如果时间允许」可用 if time permits 或独立主格 time permitting；「散步」用 take a walk / go for a walk
句型：If time permits, visitors can take a walk along the lake and enjoy the sunset.

items.zh: 旅游业的发展为当地居民创造了大量就业机会。
items.reference: The development of tourism has created a large number of job opportunities for local residents.

keyPoints.head: a large number of job opportunities

hints: 得分点：旅游业的发展 / 创造了 / 大量就业机会 / 当地居民
「创造（机会／岗位）」用 create / generate；「为某人」可用 for sb. 置于句末
句型：The development of tourism has created … for local residents.

items.zh: 无论你选择哪个季节出行，都应提前了解目的地的天气。
items.reference: No matter which season you choose to travel in, you should learn about the weather of your destination in advance.
hints: 得分点：无论哪个 / 选择出行 / 了解 / 提前
「无论……」用 no matter + 疑问词 或 whichever；「了解」可用 learn about / find out about
句型：No matter which season you choose to travel in, you should learn about … in advance.

items.zh: 离开酒店时，请记得带走所有个人物品并检查账单。
items.reference: When leaving the hotel, please remember to take all your personal belongings and check the bill.
hints: 得分点：离开酒店时 / 记得 / 个人物品 / 检查账单
「记得去做」用 remember to do（未做）；「物品」常用复数 belongings
句型：When leaving the hotel, please remember to take … and check the bill.
